name: notifyAppointmentWebhook
shortDescription: Sends real-time webhook notifications to external systems for appointment-related events.
description:
Overview

This function sends real-time webhook notifications to configured external systems whenever significant events occur related to Appointment entities (creation, update, cancellation).

Intended use

Invoked as an event handler, specifically on 'post-save' events for the Appointment entity. It ensures external systems are immediately aware of appointment lifecycle changes.

Logic

  1. Receive event data containing the Appointment record and the type of event (create, update, delete).
  2. Format the Appointment data into a JSON payload suitable for the webhook.
  3. Send the webhook notification to the configured OutboundWebhook endpoint using ctx.webhook.send.
  4. Log the webhook delivery attempt and its outcome using ctx.audit.log.
  5. Return a success or failure status.

Entities

  • Appointment
  • AuditLog

External Services

  • OutboundWebhook
